scope: Five-model capacity one-pass variant: explicit policy KV/context/automatic chunk; not four-start standard v1 or unmodified saved profiles.
reservation_policy: max(0, observed NVML total bytes - target capacity GiB); held and retouched around every request, then released. Same physical card; bandwidth/compute of smaller GPUs are not emulated.
provenance_scope: Reused verified native artifacts with source guards matching the measured commit; no new full installer/toolkit build is claimed. DLL resource versions and hashes are separate from the compiler version.
quality_scope: Speed, memory and lifecycle observation; no new independent delivered-answer quality assessment.
historical_scope: Historical repeated/KV-comparison tables are preserved; this one-start variant does not replace their outcomes or establish four-start stability.
